name: Murata Yuujirou
source:
A man who runs an advertising and showbiz company.

He is a frivolous character with no integrity, whose thinking is directed by ulterior motives and his crotch.

Truth is, his current position at the company was gained by recruiting young women to service influential persons of the business world, not because of any work related success. 

In the past, Minori, who used to live stream on the net caught his attention so he contacted her. She then ended up being utilized for "commercial activities".

Although his relationship with Minori had already ended, she contacted him thoughtlessly while she was searching for a job, and so they met once again.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hendingerg.com/products/kasen/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
